acolyte.summary: A young acolyte in a cream robe with a gold-edged stole. He holds a candle dish. The outfit and the prop match the mockup, but the hair and the sleeves have clear differences.
strengths: The face reads well. The gentle smile and the blush match the mockup.
The gold-edged stole, the star medallion, and the gold belt disc match the mockup.
The candle dish reads in all 8 sprite directions.
The cream and gold palette matches the mockup.
issues: The hair is one smooth swept slab and looks like a helmet. Make tousled locks that fall over the forehead and stick out at the sides, as in the mockup.
The sleeves are long and full and go to the fist. Make short, wide sleeves that stop at the elbow, with bare forearms.
The collar is a small square tab. Make a rolled high collar.
The belt is a thin leather strap. Make a twisted rope belt with the gold disc.
The candle flame is pale and has no glow. Make the flame brighter.
The feet have closed brown shoes. Make sandals with straps.
Walk: the robe hides the steps, the candle arm stays rigid, and the body bob is small.
acolyte.next: Rebuild the hair as tousled locks over the forehead.

banker.summary: A banker with round glasses, a bow tie, a green vest, a gold chain, a ledger, and a quill. The face and the outfit match the mockup closely, but the quill reads as a gray spoon and goes into the sleeve cuff.
strengths: The face is a strong match: round black glasses, a round nose, thick brows, and a smile.
The green vest, the gold chain, the gold badge, the gold buttons, the bow tie, the gray trousers, and the black shoes match the mockup.
The glasses and the green vest read at 128 px in every direction.
issues: The quill is a smooth gray oval blade and reads as a spoon. Its vane goes into the sleeve cuff. Make a white feather with notched edges and a dark nib, and point it up and out, away from the sleeve.
The ledger is a thin flat board. The banker holds it upright and out to the side, so it looks like a case. Make a thicker book with visible pages and tilt it against the body, as in the mockup.
The vest has no pockets. Add the two pocket flaps.
The back of the hair is one glossy smooth dome. Add strand grooves and reduce the gloss.
Walk: the ledger arm stays rigid. The motion is readable but stiff.
banker.next: Replace the quill with a white feather that points away from the sleeve.

beekeeper.summary: A beekeeper in a cream suit with a bee hat, a veil, yellow gloves, and a honey pot. The identity reads, but hair goes through the veil, and the hat brim and the boots differ from the mockup.
strengths: The bee on the hat, the yellow gloves, and the cream suit match the mockup.
The honey pot with drips and a dipper reads clearly as honey.
The smiling face with blush reads well from the front.
issues: Hair locks go through the veil. The side and back views show broken, dotted hair patches and a pale ear shape behind the veil. Keep the hair inside the veil and fix the see-through sort order.
In the walk side view (t=0.56 to 0.67), a dark patch shows on the suit at the hip behind the glove. Close the gap in the suit.
The hat brim is narrow. Make the brim much wider, as in the mockup, so that the hat is the main shape of the silhouette.
The veil is a clear side curtain. Make a honey-colored mesh that drapes over the brim and frames the face.
The shoes are short. Make tall brown boots.
The honey pot is small. Make it larger, near the size of the mockup jar.
beekeeper.next: Fix the hair and the veil so that no hair goes through the veil.

candle-maker.summary: A candle maker in an orange dress and a cream apron with wax drips. She holds a tall candle up and a short candle low. The model matches the mockup with small differences.
strengths: The bun with a curl, the side locks, and the smiling face match the mockup.
The tall raised candle with a string wrap and the short candle in the other hand match the role.
The apron has the wax-drip trim from the mockup.
The orange and cream palette matches, and both candles read in the sprites.
issues: In the side view, the white wax-drip panel of the apron sticks out from the skirt and looks like a white glove. Make it lie flat on the skirt.
The flames are pale and have no glow. Make the flames brighter.
The apron is shorter than in the mockup. Make the apron go to the knee.
The sleeves go to the fist. The mockup shows three-quarter sleeves with bare forearms.
The bun wisp is a thin hook that sticks out. Make it a thicker curl attached to the bun.
Walk: both candle arms stay rigid. The motion is readable but stiff.
candle-maker.next: Make the apron drip panel lie flat on the skirt.

courier.summary: A courier with a green beret, a white feather, a red cape, cross straps, a pack, and a sealed letter. The identity matches, but the hair, the letters, the pack, and the feather have clear differences.
strengths: The green beret, the red cape, the cross straps with a gold buckle, the belt, the shorts, and the boots match the mockup.
The smiling face reads well.
The letter has a red wax seal, as in the mockup.
issues: The hair is a ring of tight curls under the beret. Make wavy brown locks that fall over the forehead and the cheeks, as in the mockup.
The letters are small. Make two larger envelopes and hold them higher, so that they read at 128 px.
The pack is a small tan box with a stack on top. Make a larger dark brown satchel with letters that stick out.
The feather is thin and has saw teeth. Make a larger, soft plume.
The hair edge under the back of the beret has drip-shaped lobes. Make strand-shaped ends.
Walk: the cape moves a little, and the letter arm stays rigid. The motion is readable but stiff.
courier.next: Rebuild the hair as wavy locks over the forehead and the cheeks.

elder.summary: An old village elder in a brown hooded robe with a white beard, a green rope belt, sandals, and a crook staff. The face and the beard match the mockup, but the hood is a round ball, and the sleeves and the staff differ.
strengths: The white bushy brows, the round nose, and the full beard with a mustache match the mockup.
The brown robe, the knotted green rope belt, and the sandals match the mockup.
The crook staff reads in all 8 sprite directions.
issues: The hood is a large round ball. From the side and the back, it hides the head and reads as a sphere. Make a pointed hood with a peak at the back and a deeper face opening, as in the mockup.
The sleeves are narrow. Make wide bell sleeves.
The staff has gold rings below the crook. Make a cloth wrap below the crook and a darker gray-brown wood.
The fist sits at the side of the staff. Close the fist around the staff.
In the side view, the sandal straps stand up as straight posts and go through the sole. Make the straps follow the foot.
Walk: the staff stays fixed and vertical. The motion is readable but stiff.
elder.next: Reshape the hood with a peak at the back and a deeper face opening.

forager.summary: A forest forager girl with a green hood and capelet, braids, a red spotted mushroom, and a berry basket. The outfit and the props match the mockup, but a crease on the face, the small props, and the tight hood differ.
strengths: The green hood and capelet with a bow, the braids with red ties, the cream shirt, the brown skirt, and the boots match the mockup.
The red spotted mushroom and the wicker basket with berries read in the sprites.
The palette matches the mockup.
issues: A sharp V crease shows between the eyes above the nose. It looks like a frown. Smooth the nose bridge into the forehead.
The mushroom is small. Make it about two times larger, near the size of the head, as in the mockup.
The basket is small and low. Make it larger and hang it on the forearm.
The hood is a tight cap. Make it larger and softer, with a droop at the back.
The bangs are thin strands on the forehead. Make thick locks over the forehead.
Walk: both arms stay rigid. The motion is readable but stiff.
forager.next: Smooth the crease between the eyes.
